## Dataset before cleaning and pre processing


Overall Summary of the dataset
```{r}
summary(covid)
```
## Cleaning the Data

Anaylzing how many values are missing inside the data set
```{r}
sum(is.na(covid))
```

Replacing the missing values with 0
```{r}
for(col in 1:ncol(covid)){
  for(row in 1:nrow(covid)){
    if(is.na(covid[row,col]) || is.na(covid[row,col]) == " "){
      covid[row,col] <- 0
    }
  }
}

write.csv(covid, "covid_cleaned.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## Final Datset after cleaning and pre processing
```{r}
covid_cleaned <- read.csv("~/Desktop/Stat107/Stat107Final/STAT107-Project/covid_cleaned.csv")
sum(is.na(covid_cleaned))
```
